title: OSS Package Version
description: A specific version of an open source package, enriched with Sonatype Guide security, license, and quality intelligence.

packageUrl.title: Package URL (purl)
packageUrl.description: Full package URL including version, e.g. pkg:maven/org.apache.struts/struts2-core@2.5.10

version.title: Version
version.description: The version string for this component

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Human-readable name as returned by Sonatype Guide

hygieneRating.title: Hygiene Rating
hygieneRating.description: Sonatype's assessment of the component's maintenance and health (release cadence, community activity, etc.)

integrityRating.title: Integrity Rating
integrityRating.description: Sonatype's assessment of component integrity (signing, provenance, supply chain trust)

relativePopularity.title: Relative Popularity
relativePopularity.description: Popularity score (0-100) relative to other packages in the same ecosystem

effectiveLicense.title: Effective License
effectiveLicense.description: The effective SPDX license identifier for this version (e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT)

catalogDate.title: Catalog Date
catalogDate.description: The date Sonatype first cataloged this version

matchState.title: Match State
matchState.description: How accurately Sonatype Guide matched this component

securityIssueCount.title: Total Security Issues
securityIssueCount.description: Total number of open security vulnerabilities for this version

criticalCount.title: Critical Vulnerabilities
criticalCount.description: Number of CRITICAL severity security issues

highCount.title: High Vulnerabilities
highCount.description: Number of HIGH severity security issues

mediumCount.title: Medium Vulnerabilities
mediumCount.description: Number of MEDIUM severity security issues

lowCount.title: Low Vulnerabilities
lowCount.description: Number of LOW severity security issues

maxCvssScore.title: Max CVSS Score
maxCvssScore.description: Highest CVSS threat score across all security issues for this version

vulnerabilitySummary.title: Vulnerability Summary
vulnerabilitySummary.description: Markdown-formatted summary of open vulnerabilities (CVE ID, severity, CVSS score)

guideUrl.title: Sonatype Guide URL
guideUrl.description: Direct link to this component version on Sonatype Guide

lastSyncedAt.title: Last Synced
lastSyncedAt.description: When this entity was last refreshed from Sonatype Guide

securityPosture.title: Security Posture
securityPosture.calculation: if .properties.criticalCount > 0 then "Critical Risk" elif .properties.highCount > 0 then "High Risk" elif .properties.mediumCount > 0 then "Medium Risk" elif .properties.lowCount > 0 then "Low Risk" else "Clean" end

qualityScore.title: Overall Quality Score
qualityScore.calculation: if (.properties.hygieneRating == "Excellent" and .properties.integrityRating == "Excellent") then "Excellent" elif (.properties.hygieneRating == "Poor" or .properties.integrityRating == "Poor") then "Poor" elif (.properties.hygieneRating == "Good" and (.properties.integrityRating == "Good" or .properties.integrityRating == "Excellent")) then "Good" else "Fair" end

package.title: OSS Package
package.description: The parent package this version belongs to
